subject: A few questions about reactivity (part 1: lists inside reactiveValues)

messages.author: 80defc9c4046a73b
messages.subject: A few questions about reactivity (part 1: lists inside reactiveValues)
parts:
Given the following...

foo <- reactiveValues(alist=list(a=1,b=2),xlist=list(x=3,y=4));

...I found by trial and error (no wonder I kept getting endless loops) that:

foo$alist$a <- 42  will cause observe({foo$alist$b; ...}) to invalidate. In other words, only top-level objects inside foo are independent of each other but updating a sub-object is equivalent to updating the parent object.

I have several lists of session-specific variables and I want to keep the lists separate from each other (so I could, for example, iterate over foo$xlist without also iterating over foo$alist). Will any of the following work in a stable manner?

foo <- list(alist=reactiveValues(a=1,b=2),xlist=reactiveValues(x=3,y=4));
alist=reactiveValues(a=1,b=2); xlist=reactiveValues(x=3,y=4); foo<-list(alist,xlist);

...or is the recommended practice just to have each and every such list be a separate reactiveValues object at the top level of shinyServer()'s environment?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: A few questions about reactivity (part 1: lists inside reactiveValues)
parts: It seems like any of those would work stably--but I'd recommend using an empty environment instead of a list, only because the copying semantics are clearer.
